# Team onboarding

What a new engineer does in the first week.

1. Request access to the repository, the issue tracker and the team chat
   from the team lead.
2. Clone the repository and run the test suite once to confirm the setup.
3. Read `docs/architecture.md` and the rules in `.claude/rules/`.
4. Pair with a teammate on one small issue tagged `good-first-issue`.
5. Join the weekly planning meeting and present what was learned.
